We can see this at restaurants with their conch fritters and mahi sandwiches, bars with their cover bands, and booze cruise sunset sails with their jimmy Buffet covers. All these are great! But sometimes you want to take a risk and see if you can find the reward of a real, unique experience! To kick Ages 13+ • 2 Hours • Beer, Wine, Snacks and LIVE music Included!
